stories.title: Welsh Government waives £540,000 in Flintshire recycling fines
stories.summary: More than £540,000 in Welsh Government fines against Flintshire County Council for missing recycling targets have been dropped, after the council switched to three-weekly black bin collections. The fines totalled £356,279 for 2022/23 and £184,340 for 2023/24. They had been imposed by Welsh Government after Flintshire fell short of statutory recycling targets in those years.
